title: 第3章 先搞钱第4章 真金不怕火炼
lines: “宁尚书，如果不想落个虐待幼子的名声，劳烦派人送几床厚一点的被褥和衣衫来。”
宁宸放声大喊。
他知道宁自明是个极为好面子的人，他不会让自己落下这个的恶名。
宁自明听到了，但脸色却更加难看了。
宁甘快步追上来，讨好地说道：“父亲别生气，宁宸就是想以这样的方式引起您的注意，别理他就行了...饿他几天，他发现这招没用，肯定会来求父亲原谅。”
“对，绝对不能让他得逞，竟敢要挟父亲，还敢用木材砸我们，简直无法无天。”
宁茂帮腔。
宁自明没有说话，来到后院一个房间前。
还没进门，就听到了哭声。
宁甘殷勤地掀开帘子，宁自明走了进去。
房间奢华，温暖。
宁兴躺在床上，额头缠着白布，有殷红地鲜血渗出。
床边，一个体态丰腴的妇人正在哭泣。
她就是当朝左相常怀礼之女，常如月。
常如月看到宁自明，擦了擦眼泪，起身行礼，带着哭腔道：“老爷回来了？”
宁自明嗯了一声，看向床上的宁兴，问道：“兴儿怎么样了？可有找大夫来瞧过？”
常如月呜咽着说道：
“大夫已经来过了，兴儿伤得很重，说要卧床静养一阵子。”
宁自明眉头紧皱，脸色难看。
“这个野...”宁茂正要说野种，常如月一个眼神，他立马改口，“二哥真可怜，平日里有什么好吃好喝的都给宁宸留着，没想到他不但偷二哥的玉佩，还下此毒手，太过分了！”
常如月柳眉微蹙，责备道：
“不要这样说自己的弟弟，宁宸毕竟是从乡野小村来的，缺乏管教...也是我这个做母亲的失责，没有管教好他。”
宁甘急忙道：“母亲，这跟你有什么关系？分明是那宁宸的错，你怎么能把责任揽到自己身上呢？”
常如月擦拭着眼角并不存在的眼泪，叹口气说道：
“宁宸是顽劣了些，但这也不是他一个人的错，是母亲没有好好管教他。”
“你们兄弟二人，不能因为这件事就怪他...他虽然不是母亲所生，但我一直待他视如己出。”
宁自明本想问问宁宸缺衣少穿的事，但听到常如月这样说，越发肯定宁宸在撒谎。
哼，真是顽劣成性，满嘴谎言，孺子不可教。
“宁宸以下欺上，手段歹毒...来人，封锁西院，没有我的命令，不准他踏出西院半步。”
宁自明满脸厌烦地说道。
常如月嘴角露出一抹诡笑...她的段位，可比她三个儿子高多了。
西院，柴叔扶着宁宸回到房间。
content_en:
"Ning Shangshu, if you don't want to be known as abusing your young son, please send someone to bring some thicker bedding and clothes."
Ning Chen shouted loudly.
He knew that Ning Ziming was a very face-saving person, and he would not let himself get such a bad reputation.
Ning Ziming heard it, but his face became even more ugly.
Ning Gan quickly caught up and said flatteringly: "Father, don't be angry. Ning Chen just wants to attract your attention in this way. Just ignore him... Starve him for a few days. If he finds that this trick is useless, he will definitely come to ask for father's forgiveness."
"Yes, we must not let him succeed. He dares to threaten my father and hit us with wood. It is simply lawless."
Ning Mao helped.
Ning Ziming said nothing and came to a room in the backyard.
Before I even entered the door, I heard crying.
Ning Gan diligently opened the curtain, and Ning Ziming walked in.
The rooms are luxurious and warm.
Ning Xing was lying on the bed, with a white cloth wrapped around his forehead, and bright red blood seeping out.
Beside the bed, a plump woman was crying.
She was the daughter of the then left prime minister who was always courteous, always like the moon.
When Chang Ruyue saw Ning Ziming, she wiped her tears, stood up and saluted, and said in a tearful voice, "Master is back?"
Ning Ziming hummed, looked at Ning Xing on the bed, and asked, "How is Xing'er? Have you seen a doctor?"
Chang Ruyue whimpered and said:
"The doctor has already arrived. Xing'er was seriously injured and said he will stay in bed for a while."
Ning Ziming frowned and looked ugly.
"This bastard..." Ning Mao was about to say bastard when Chang Ruyue gave him a look and he immediately changed his mind, "Second brother is so pitiful. He keeps all the good food and drinks for Ning Chen on weekdays. I didn't expect that he not only stole the jade pendant from second brother, but also did this murder. It's too much!"
Chang Ruyue frowned slightly and said reproachfully:
"Don't talk about your brother like that. After all, Ning Chen comes from a small rural village. He lacks discipline... It's also my fault as a mother. I didn't discipline him well."
Ning Gan said hurriedly: "Mother, what does this have to do with you? It's clearly Ning Chen's fault, how can you take the responsibility on yourself?"
Chang Ruyue wiped the non-existent tears from the corner of her eyes, sighed and said:
"Ning Chen is a bit naughty, but it's not his fault alone. It's his mother who didn't discipline him well."
"You two brothers, you can't blame him for this...Although he was not born of my mother, I have always treated him as my own."
Ning Ziming originally wanted to ask Ning Chen about his lack of clothes, but when he heard what Chang Ruyue said, he became more and more sure that Ning Chen was lying.
Humph, he is really naughty, full of lies, and cannot be taught.
"Ning Chen is bullying his superiors with vicious methods... Someone has come and sealed off the west courtyard. Without my order, he is not allowed to step out of the west courtyard."
Ning Ziming said with a bored look on his face.
A sly smile appeared on Chang Ruyue's lips... Her rank was much higher than that of her three sons.
...
In the west courtyard, Uncle Chai helped Ning Chen back to the room.
